Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

NPU diffusion startup emits warnings from CUDA-only features, legacy tensor serialization, and unsupported internal-format settings. This PR reduces unnecessary console output.

## Modifications

- Skip CUDA-only GELU fusion registration and numerics settings on NPU.
- Defer the MiniMax sparse-attention import until its backend is used.
- Use zip serialization for CPU tensors in worker configuration payloads.
- Avoid logging the same static fusion rejection repeatedly.
- Keep the existing numerics tests working on CPU. No new test cases are included.

## Accuracy Tests

Python syntax and whitespace checks passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. No inference speed improvement is claimed.

- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+            return False
+
         if self.reject_reason is not None:

                 reason = self.reject_reason(site)
                 if reason is None:
                     continue

+def _restore_config_tensor(data: bytes):

+
+
+class _ConfigPickler(pickle.Pickler):
+    def reducer_override(self, obj):
+        import torch
+
+        if isinstance(obj, torch.Tensor) and obj.device.type == "cpu":
+            # Tensor's pickle reducer uses legacy torch.save, which warns on NPU.
+            buffer = io.BytesIO()
+            torch.save(obj, buffer, _use_new_zipfile_serialization=True)
+            return _restore_config_tensor, (buffer.getvalue(),)
+        return NotImplemented
+
